elevation_source: USGS National Map Elevation Point Query Service (EPQS), https://epqs.nationalmap.gov/v1/json, queried 2026-08-20
notes: Elevation, obstruction distances, and heights are field estimates from the station operator plus USGS EPQS spot checks. Precision is roughly +/-10ft on distances and +/-5ft on tree heights unless re-surveyed.

line_obstructions.name: West hardwood treeline
line_obstructions.description: North-south hardwood treeline west of the antenna, at least 800ft long, beginning ~200ft north of the due-west line and extending south from there
line_obstructions.assumption: North end fixed at +200ft (200ft north of the due-west line through the antenna); south end at -600ft, i.e. 800ft south of the north end -- the operator's stated minimum length. The row may run further south than -600ft; if so this understates obstruction for the southernmost few degrees of its span. Adjust along_line_start_ft if a longer confirmed extent is known.

line_obstructions.name: East pine row
line_obstructions.description: Row of pine trees roughly 5 deg west of north to 5 deg east of south, ~350ft long, centered ~200ft east of the antenna

arc_obstructions.name: SE tall pine cluster
arc_obstructions.description: Tall pines, at least 70ft, azimuth 120-140 deg

arc_obstructions.name: S tall pine cluster
arc_obstructions.description: Tall pines, at least 70ft, azimuth 180-195 deg

arc_obstructions.name: Far south ridge and hardwoods
arc_obstructions.description: Rising terrain plus ~75ft hardwoods roughly 500ft south; modeled across 150-210 deg (South America region window) as a floor that the nearer SE/S pine clusters override where they overlap
arc_obstructions.height_breakdown: 75ft canopy override + 14.28ft measured terrain rise at 500ft south (USGS EPQS: 1588.16ft vs site 1573.88ft)

receiver_noise_figure_db._meta: Operator-supplied station values, at the antenna feedpoint (preamp mounted at the dish, feedline loss after the preamp not modeled). Supplied 2026-08-21, replacing the earlier generic placeholder table.

dem_octant_samples_ft._meta: USGS EPQS point elevations at 2000ft range on each principal bearing from the antenna, queried 2026-08-20. Used as a coarse regional 'terrain floor' between/beyond the explicit obstruction features above via piecewise-linear interpolation by azimuth. This is NOT a full ray-marched horizon profile -- see README Methodology & Limitations.
